tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ Implement and test a re-runnable boardctl status normalization sweep with dry-run and apply semantics for one board without guessing unknown statuses; add a reported-vs-verified completion marker and expose its counts on board-report/v1; document alias warning policy; include traceability links to row, source, tests, evidence, and commit.: Most sub-requirements are met, but the traceability clause is entirely missing. MET: (a) sweep — internal/board/statusnormalize.go:38 NormalizeStatuses(apply) classifies one board only (b.tasksPath), dry-run default (DryRun: !apply, no write), apply does one atomicRewrite with a guard that untouched lines are byte-identical (statusnormalize.go:120-131); unknown/missing statuses are counted and refused, never coerced (statusnormalize.go:78-95, ResolveStatus at internal/board/read.go:57-65); CLI cmd/boardctl/statusnormalize.go:11-70 exposes --dry-run/--apply/--json/-C and is wired at cmd/boardctl/main.go:226. Re-runnable/idempotent: internal/board/statusnormalize_test.go TestNormalizeStatusesApplyIsAtomicAndIdempotent asserts second apply Changed==0 and byte-identical file. (b) reported-vs-verified marker — internal/render/derive.go:147-151 adds ReportedCompleteCount/VerifiedCompleteCount/UnverifiedCompleteCount with json tags reported_complete_count/verified_complete_count/unverified_complete_count, computed at derive.go:237-241 via board.RowEvidenceRunIDs (detail.evidence[].run_id or top-level evidence_run_id, internal/board/evidence_gate.go:100-116); these ride the board-report/v1 payload (confirmed present in cmd/boardctl/board-report.html:114 report-data island). (c) alias warning policy documented — docs/specs/board-analytics-report.md:398-412 (§3.9/§3.9a: read-tolerated aliases warn, canonical writes, single-board dry-run default, owner-gated fleet apply), docs/operations.md:34-43 (§1b), skills/boardctl-usage/SKILL.md:197-206. TESTS RUN FRESH: `go test -count=1 ./...` exit_code 0 — all packages ok (cmd/boardctl 6.583s, internal/board 1.698s, internal/render 0.036s); targeted `go test -count=1 -run 'NormalizeStatuses|ReportedVerified' -v ./internal/board/ ./internal/render/ ./cmd/boardctl/` exit_code 0 with `--- PASS: TestNormalizeStatusesDryRunPreservesBytesAndRefusesUnknown`, `--- PASS: TestNormalizeStatusesApplyIsAtomicAndIdempotent`, `--- PASS: TestDerivedReportedVerifiedCompleteCounts`, `--- PASS: TestNormalizeStatusesCLIHelpAndDryRun`, `--- PASS: TestNormalizeStatusesCLIApplyLeavesUnknownRefused`, `--- PASS: TestNormalizeStatusesHelpDocumentsScope`. MISSING: the required traceability links to row, source, tests, evidence, and commit. The repo's convention is a `ch:trace row=... spec=... test=... evidence=... commit=...` trailer (internal/board/keys.go:114-119; examples README.md:1692, docs/dogfood/2026-10-29-run27-integration.md:74). No ch:trace marker exists for BT-81 anywhere (grep over docs/, README.md, skills/ returns only unrelated rows). The board row .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl BT-81 still reads status "pending" with commit_hash null, completed_at null, and no evidence/evidence_run_id; .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl has only task_created (id 560) and task_updated blocked (id 561) — no completion event carrying a trace marker. Commit e81a8c8's message says only "Addresses BT-81" and contains no row/source/test/evidence/commit links. The only BT-81 mention in docs is a bare comment at skills/boardctl-usage/SKILL.md:197, which is not a traceability link set.
The normalization sweep, reported-vs-verified counts on board-report/v1, and alias-warning policy docs are implemented and all tests pass, but the required traceability links (row, source, tests, evidence, commit) are absent — no ch:trace marker, no board row/event evidence, and the commit message carries no links.
